title: Multimedia in HTML
description: Learn how to embed and control images, audio, and video content in web pages using HTML.

lessons.title: Introduction to Multimedia in HTML
lessons.content: Multimedia elements such as images, audio, and video enhance the user experience and make web pages more interactive and engaging.

lessons.title: Adding Images with
lessons.content: // The tag is used to embed images into web pages.

lessons.title: Image Attributes and Best Practices
lessons.content: Always include `alt` text for accessibility. Use `width` and `height` to control image display and prevent layout shifts.

lessons.title: Embedding Audio with <audio>
lessons.content:
<audio controls>
  <source src="audio.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>

lessons.title: Embedding Video with <video>
lessons.content:
<video width="640" height="360" controls>
  <source src="video.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

lessons.title: Audio and Video Attributes
lessons.content: Common attributes include `controls`, `autoplay`, `loop`, `muted`, and `poster` for videos. Always provide fallback content.

lessons.title: Responsive Images with <picture>
Using SVG in HTML
lessons.content:
<svg width="100" height="100">
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" fill="red" />
</svg>
// SVG allows vector-based images that scale cleanly.

lessons.title: Multimedia Accessibility Tips
lessons.content: Use `alt` for images, provide captions and transcripts for video/audio, and ensure controls are keyboard-accessible.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Media Performance
lessons.content: Compress media files, use modern formats (like WebP, MP4), lazy-load where possible, and use CDN for faster delivery.
